subject: Sourcing: vendor shortlist for LLM eval & labeling pilot
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Sourcing: vendor shortlist for LLM eval & labeling pilot

Team —

We need to move forward on a short pilot for prompt evaluation + labeling to validate quality and unit cost before we scale into Redwood Optimize. High-level ask: 3-month engagement, ~5k prompt evals (multi-turn), and ~50k labeled items across intent/slot/error-class labels. Primary goals: measurable eval metrics (precision/recall), inter-annotator agreement, and quick turnaround for iterative prompt tests.

Questions I have:
- Who do we want to include in the RFP/contact list? I pulled two vendors we used in past threads: EvalWorks and AnnotatePro — any other suggestions?
- Budget guardrail: target <= $55k for pilot (including SOW, project mgmt).
- Timeline: ideally kickoff in the first week of Jan and deliver first batch within 3 weeks of kickoff.

Please reply with vendor recommendations, any must-have compliance evidence (SOC2, IP clauses), and someone to own ops/PO.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sourcing: vendor shortlist for LLM eval & labeling pilot

+1 to EvalWorks and AnnotatePro. A few quick clarifications/asks so vendors get an apples-to-apples scope:

- Deliverables: 5,000 human evals across 3 prompt families; per-eval rubric + yes/no pass; separate edge-case bucket for hallucination review. Labels: 50k rows with fields: intent, slot-values (structured), error_reason, confidence.
- Quality gates: target Cohen's kappa > 0.7 and per-class precision >= 85% for core intents.
- Tools/hand-off: we prefer CSV + standardized JSON mapping + sample of gold-labeled 500 rows.
- Compliance: SOC2 report and privacy addendum required.

Monica — can you run a quick budget check? Neha — can you ping legal for a light MSA/redline turnaround target (5 business days)? I'll prepare a short vendor scorecard template.

Marissa
Senior PM, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@evalworks.ai>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@annotatepro.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot RFP: LLM prompt evals + labeling (scope attached)

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Redwood is soliciting short proposals for a 3-month pilot covering prompt evaluations and data labeling. Attached is the pilot scope doc (pilot_scope_v2.docx) with expected sample sizes and acceptance criteria. Top-line asks:
- Fixed-price SOW for the pilot (include per-unit and any overage rates)
- SOC2 or equivalent security evidence and standard privacy addendum
- Proposed resourcing and timeline (kickoff availability in early Jan)
- Example deliverable format + sample mapping to our schema

We're cc'ing Marissa and Monica on ops and budget. Please reply with a short proposal and any initial questions by EOD Thu (Dec 3). We can schedule a 30-min sync if needed — availability this week is limited but we can do Jan 4–6 for kickoff.

Thanks,
Karthik
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@evalworks.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@evalworks.ai, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot RFP: LLM prompt evals + labeling (scope attached)

Hi Karthik / team —

Thanks for the scope. EvalWorks is excited to submit a proposal — high-level summary below and SOW attached. Attachments: EvalWorks_SOW_v1.pdf, EvalWorks_SOC2_Attestation_2025.pdf.

Proposal highlights:
- Fixed price pilot: $49,500 covering 5k prompt evals + 50k label rows, two rounds of QA and one gold-set calibration.
- Timeline: kickoff week of Jan 4, 2027; first delivery (gold set + 1k evals) within 3 weeks of kickoff; remaining batches bi-weekly.
- Staffing: 1 PM, 2 QA leads, 6 annotators; project manager acts as single point of contact.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 Type II attestation (attached); we will execute Redwood's privacy addendum.

Open items:
1) Confirmation of acceptance criteria for the hallucination edge-case bucket.
2) Clarify whether we should use Redwood's internal labeling UI or work from CSV/JSON exports.

We are available for a 30-min sync on Fri Dec 4 09:00–11:00 PST or Mon Jan 4 after 10:00 PST.

Best,
Sarah Lin
Director, Solutions — EvalWorks
From: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@annotatepro.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot RFP: LLM prompt evals + labeling (scope attached)

Hi Karthik / team —

Appreciate the invite. AnnotatePro can support the scope but we also propose an alternate 'on-demand' model that may reduce up-front cost:
- Baseline pilot price: $38,000 for a two-phase run (calibration + 40k labels) with option to buy additional 10k label packs at $1.20/row.
- Faster ramp: sample deliverable within 2 weeks (smaller gold set of 250 rows for faster iteration).
- We do not currently publish a SOC2 attestation but can provide a security questionnaire and references; we can execute Redwood's privacy addendum and sign a more restrictive NDA if needed.

Attached: AnnotatePro_Proposal.xlsx (pricing breakdown + timeline).

If SOC2 is a hard requirement, I understand if that disqualifies us for this pilot; happy to discuss hybrid approaches.

Thanks,
Tom Rivera
Head of Partnerships — AnnotatePro
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@evalworks.ai>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@annotatepro.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 14:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot RFP: LLM prompt evals + labeling (scope attached)

Thanks to both vendors for fast turnarounds. Quick internal notes:

- Budget: finance flagged that $49.5k is within our target but we need a PO + confirmation on invoicing cadence. I'll loop Finance after Karthik signals intent.
- Security: EvalWorks' SOC2 is a plus. Legal (Neha) — please review EvalWorks_SOW_v1.pdf and the SOC2 attestation and confirm any redlines; target turnaround = 5 business days.
- Ops: Marissa, can you run the vendor scorecard and evaluate based on cost, compliance, and speed to first batch?

Decision leaning: prefer EvalWorks for a straight pilot because it meets compliance and the fixed scope. AnnotatePro offers interesting flexibility and lower price — consider as follow-on capacity if needed.

Monica
Program Manager, Customer Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@evalworks.ai>, procurement@evalworks.ai
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 5 Dec 2026 16:44:00 -0800
Subject: Final: greenlight for EvalWorks 3-month pilot (next steps)

Hi Sarah / EvalWorks procurement —

Thanks for the proposal and SOC2 evidence. Redwood is greenlighting a 3-month pilot with EvalWorks per your SOW (EvalWorks_SOW_v1.pdf) at $49,500. Next steps:

1) EvalWorks to confirm SOW acceptance and return a countersigned copy.
2) Redwood procurement will issue a PO (finance contact: finance@redwood.ai). Monica will confirm invoicing cadence.
3) Kickoff window: week of Jan 4, 2027 — propose Jan 5 at 10:00 PST for a 30-min kickoff; please confirm.
4) Legal (Neha) will send any lightweight redlines; please expect a single MSA addendum for pilot terms.

Marissa — please own vendor ops and run the scorecard for continuous evaluation. Monica — please coordinate PO with Finance.
